activitylistener-sampling-cost-boundary.title: Choose ActivityListener sampling before paying tracing costs
activitylistener-sampling-cost-boundary.short: Sampling controls how much trace data is created
activitylistener-sampling-cost-boundary.summary: ActivityListener sampling decides whether an Activity is created and whether tags and events should be recorded.
activitylistener-sampling-cost-boundary.why: Recording every operation can add allocation and export cost on high-throughput paths.
activitylistener-sampling-cost-boundary.tips: Filter sources early and choose a sampling result that matches the diagnostic detail actually required.

json-streaming-deserialization-memory-bo.title: Stream large JSON sequences instead of materializing them
json-streaming-deserialization-memory-bo.short: Process JSON elements while reading the stream
json-streaming-deserialization-memory-bo.summary: DeserializeAsyncEnumerable can expose JSON array elements incrementally so processing does not require a complete in-memory object list.
json-streaming-deserialization-memory-bo.why: Materializing a large payload before processing increases peak memory and delays useful work.
json-streaming-deserialization-memory-bo.tips: Keep downstream processing bounded and propagate cancellation through both deserialization and processing.

socket-cancellation-lifetime-boundary.title: Define cancellation and shutdown semantics for async sockets
socket-cancellation-lifetime-boundary.short: Cancellation, EOF, and disposal mean different things
socket-cancellation-lifetime-boundary.summary: Asynchronous socket loops need an explicit contract for cancellation, orderly peer shutdown, and local disposal.
socket-cancellation-lifetime-boundary.why: Treating every zero-byte read or cancellation as the same failure makes reconnect and shutdown behavior unreliable.
socket-cancellation-lifetime-boundary.tips: Handle a zero-byte receive as peer shutdown, propagate expected cancellation separately, and centralize socket ownership.

libraryimport-generated-marshalling-boun.title: Use LibraryImport when generated interop marshalling fits the contract
libraryimport-generated-marshalling-boun.short: Generate native-call marshalling at build time
libraryimport-generated-marshalling-boun.summary: LibraryImport source generation can move supported P/Invoke marshalling work to build time and make native signatures more analyzable.
libraryimport-generated-marshalling-boun.why: Implicit or mismatched marshalling rules can create hidden conversions and native ABI bugs.
libraryimport-generated-marshalling-boun.tips: Specify string and custom marshalling deliberately and verify the native ABI rather than copying a declaration mechanically.

regex-source-generation-startup-tradeoff.title: Use generated regular expressions when startup and AOT matter
regex-source-generation-startup-tradeoff.short: Move regex construction work to generated code
regex-source-generation-startup-tradeoff.summary: GeneratedRegex emits an implementation at build time, reducing runtime parsing and fitting environments where dynamic code is constrained.
regex-source-generation-startup-tradeoff.why: Repeated runtime regex construction adds startup work and can conflict with NativeAOT-oriented deployment choices.
regex-source-generation-startup-tradeoff.tips: Use generation for stable patterns and still apply timeout or non-backtracking choices where untrusted input can cause expensive matching.

aspnetcore-request-body-size-boundary.title: Bound ASP.NET Core request bodies before buffering them
aspnetcore-request-body-size-boundary.short: Do not turn an unbounded body into one giant string or array
aspnetcore-request-body-size-boundary.summary: Request-body limits and streaming protect server memory when endpoints accept large or attacker-controlled payloads.
aspnetcore-request-body-size-boundary.why: Reading an unrestricted body completely into memory lets one request consume disproportionate resources.
aspnetcore-request-body-size-boundary.tips: Set appropriate server or endpoint limits, reject oversized input, and stream formats that can be processed incrementally.

exception-aggregation-parallel-work.title: Preserve all failures from parallel asynchronous work
exception-aggregation-parallel-work.short: One await can represent several failed operations
exception-aggregation-parallel-work.summary: Task.WhenAll coordinates parallel tasks, but diagnostic code may need to inspect the aggregate task to retain every underlying failure.
exception-aggregation-parallel-work.why: Logging only the exception observed at one boundary can hide sibling failures that occurred in the same parallel operation.
exception-aggregation-parallel-work.tips: Keep the WhenAll task, await it, and inspect its Exception for diagnostics when multiple simultaneous failures matter.

arraypool-capacity-not-logical-length.title: Treat ArrayPool rent size as capacity, not data length
arraypool-capacity-not-logical-length.short: A rented array may be larger than requested
arraypool-capacity-not-logical-length.summary: ArrayPool.Rent guarantees at least the requested capacity, so the returned array length is not the number of valid bytes or elements.
arraypool-capacity-not-logical-length.why: Writing the entire rented array can expose stale bytes or append unintended data beyond the logical payload.
arraypool-capacity-not-logical-length.tips: Track logical length separately and slice reads and writes to that length before returning the buffer.

unity-job-batch-size-scheduling-overhead.title: Balance Unity job batch size against scheduling overhead
unity-job-batch-size-scheduling-overhead.short: Batch size trades load balancing for scheduler work
unity-job-batch-size-scheduling-overhead.summary: Parallel Unity jobs divide iterations into batches; batch size influences scheduling overhead and how evenly work is distributed.
unity-job-batch-size-scheduling-overhead.why: Very small batches can spend too much time scheduling, while very large batches can leave worker threads unevenly loaded.
unity-job-batch-size-scheduling-overhead.tips: Measure representative workloads and tune batch size only after confirming scheduling is material to frame time.

reflection-trimming-dynamic-access-contr.title: Declare reflection requirements for trimming and NativeAOT
reflection-trimming-dynamic-access-contr.short: Tell the linker which members dynamic code needs
reflection-trimming-dynamic-access-contr.summary: DynamicallyAccessedMembers and related annotations express reflection requirements that static trimming analysis cannot infer by itself.
reflection-trimming-dynamic-access-contr.why: Code that works without trimming can lose reflected members in trimmed or NativeAOT deployments.
reflection-trimming-dynamic-access-contr.tips: Prefer statically visible access or source generation, and annotate unavoidable reflection at the narrowest API boundary.
